label: reset
annotation: ===== Power-on reset: hardware init, RAM setup, then the main loop.

label: isr_ta3_coils
annotation: ===== Timer A3: fire the queued coils. If enabled ($0944.0) and coil_fire_mask $0A0C is non-zero, OR it into the coil output image $0A98 and drive the outputs via $C502. The mask is built one cylinder ahead by build_coil_mask ($4A3A); timing is set in the INT2 REF handler. Per-cylinder advance trims apply there, not here.

label: isr_tb2
annotation: ===== Timer B2 interrupt: knock chip per-cylinder value + watchdog ($021F.3 from 2nd CPU)

label: isr_ta4
annotation: ===== Timer A4: program the knock interface chip for one cylinder. If the chip is OK (kchip_state $0DD0.0), fetch the per-cylinder detection-window value ($4576/$4579, table $0DE1) + offset $0DD5 (clamp $FFFF) and write control/data to $030262/$030266 (bank-3 I/O). See ROM_ANALYSIS.md §8b. Timer B2 ($44B6) does the same + the watchdog.

label: isr_ta2
annotation: ===== Timer A2 interrupt: dispatches on ta2_flags (crank POS / timing events ?)

label: isr_int2_ref
annotation: ===== INT2: crank REF (120 deg) edge. Captures the REF period (ref_period, Consult 02/03) and schedules ignition (coil_fire_mask). The old listing called this "knock": it isn't.

label: sched_tick
annotation: ===== Main scheduler tick (UART0 TX interrupt used as a periodic timer), then the task list: sensor reads, fuel, ignition, idle, diagnostics, Consult replies.

label: consult_isr
annotation: ===== Consult serial interrupt (RX and TX share this vector) Init: FF FF ED -> 12. Commands: FF re-init, 30 stop, 5A reg, C9 mem, 0A test, D0 part no, D1 codes, C1 codes+clear, 51 (hidden: report+clear dtc_seen). Anything else -> FE. F0 starts the reply; only FF / 30 are accepted while streaming.

label: c9_find_hidden
annotation: C9: queue addresses in $5D40-$623F (and FE00-FFCF if CONFIG $1207.5) as addr-$5000 for the second CPU. consult_reply_c9 fills one of them per frame from c9_sub_value.

label: consult_reset
annotation: Reset Consult state after stop / re-init (keeps init if 30 was sent).

label: calc_rpm
annotation: Writes rpm_hi/rpm_lo (Consult 00/01). Derive rpm from the captured REF period. First shift the rpm history ring $0994-$09A6 up by 2 (even-aligned, exits at $0992), then rpm = reciprocal-multiply of the period ($A0 << 1) by $A6AB, result >>2 -> rpm_lo $0994 (Consult 01); $09AE/$09AC are the derived RPM values, NOT load. $09AE=min(RPM word,255); $09B0=min(word>>1,255); $09B1=low byte(word>>2). Units are 12.5, 25 and 50 rpm respectively.

label: L_66BA
annotation: Fuel-quantity scaling step (fuel task, slot 1/6). Computes $0A74 x cal $1AAB x CAL/LD ($0ABD) as a 32-bit product, clamps to $FFFF if the top 5 bits would overflow the <<5 fixed-point scale, -> $0A6E. The 2D fuel-map lookup itself is in bank 1 (§8); this is the bank-0 load/airflow scaling around it. Final alpha (test 81 $0730/$0731) and per-cylinder trims are applied later in calc_injection ($6A20).

label: calc_injection
annotation: Writes inj_a / inj_b (Consult 14/15, 22/23). Final injector pulse width per bank -> inj_a/inj_b (Consult 14/15, 22/23). Loops the two banks (base $0A8C/$0A8E, alternated by the low bit of the counter), and for each applies the per-cylinder trim words at $0A24+ with SATURATING math: a negative trim subtracts and clamps to 0, a positive trim adds and clamps to $FFFF. The $0A97 mask skips cylinders not due. Base pulse comes from the upstream fuel calc (map x alpha).

label: fuel_feedback
annotation: A/F feedback: writes alpha_a/alpha_b (Consult 1A/1B); test 81 overrides alpha. A/F closed-loop (O2) feedback, one bank per call. Start an O2-sensor ADC read ($20/$22), choose closed vs open loop from the rpm index ($09B1 vs $1BAD) and speed ($098B vs $1BD1) each with +2 hysteresis, then step the alpha trim (alpha_a/alpha_b $0730/$0731 = Consult 1A/1B) on each O2 rich<->lean crossing. Test 81 ($07B7.2) overrides alpha with its value $0770 clamped to 4B-7D ($6E15). Above the rpm/speed limits it runs open-loop.

label: calc_switches
annotation: Writes sw13 (Consult 13 switch bits). Build the engine-condition / switch bitfield $092B (Consult reg 31 reads $092B.6) and the $0941/$094B/$094F state bits from second-CPU inputs ($0211), engine state (RPM code $09AE, $0ABE CAL/LD), against calibration thresholds ($228A/$228B, $15FE/ $15FF). Hysteresis throughout, e.g. $094B.2 is set at load>=$50 and cleared at <$10. Called each adc_task cycle ($4054) and from $4D81.

label: purge_stepper_out
annotation: Drives output ports from purge_step: 4-phase stepper (ECM pins 26/27/110/118) ?

label: calc_monitor_admission
annotation: Build blocker bits $0F6F, then $98E6 encodes the first blocker as $80-$87 in $0F6D (Consult 61).

label: consult_task
annotation: ===== Consult reply builder, run from the scheduler. Builds cs_payload for the command received, then consult_send_frame queues it.

label: consult_reply_direct
annotation: 0A direct mode: stream the RAM addresses in cs_streamlist.

label: calc_outputs
annotation: Writes out1E/out1F/out20 (Consult 1E/1F/20) and registers 30, 49, 4E, 4F.

label: checksum_add
call_sites: A3B5 A3BC A3C3 A3D8 A3DF A3E6 A3ED A3F4 A3FB A402 A409 A410 A41E

label: diag_task_a4db
annotation: Diagnostic monitor (sets dtc_conf / dtc_seen; uses coolant, speed, load).

label: idle_control
annotation: ===== Idle air control: writes iacv_step (Consult 18). Test 85 forces the step (max 81), test 8C forces a fixed path. IACV-AAC idle-air control (Consult reg 18 = $0BC5/applied at $B054). Normal path: interp16 of table $2160 by $0981 for the base step, A/C step-up ($2209 -> $0BDF) and a decay. Active-test overrides: test 8C ($07B8.10) forces the air path via $BC22/ $22AF ($ACA5); test 85 ($07B7.20) forces the step from its value $0774, clamped $81.

label: calc_idle_speed_target
annotation: Build target idle-speed code: temperature table $2150, operating-condition clamps, then rejected-test-83 override at $B39A. $0BCD feeds the $0BCB ramp and idle loop.

label: L_B99C
call_sites: B3B2 B3BF B428 B46D B4D7 B4E4

label: purge_control
annotation: ===== EVAP purge volume control (P0443's valve) ?: writes purge_step (Consult 29). Test 98 forces the step. EVAP canister purge volume control valve rate calc (this car's stored P0443 circuit). Gated by enable flags ($0968, idle/load $092A/$0931); computes a purge rate from calibration $2B46/$2B48 scaled by the purge map ($0E0E x $0E10), accumulated with saturation into $0563/$0565. Rate is 0 when disabled or below the $2B4A load threshold (FSM: 0 step when stopped). The step-count code at $C038 (interp32 of table $29A0 by $0E0D) writes purge_step $0806 (Consult reg 29); $9488 drives the 4-phase VCV outputs on ECM pins 26/27/110/118. Test 98 ($07BA.0) overrides the step ($BFB3).

label: mailbox_receive
annotation: ===== Takes a message from the second CPU ($02A0-$02FE, even bytes), type = $029E & 7. Type 0 fills the detection flags $0E51-$0E58 (misfire, catalyst, EVAP incl. P0443, O2, EGR...).

label: L_CAD7
annotation: Decode nine second-CPU requests ($20,$21,$60,$61,$A0-$A4), return two bytes in $07FB/$07FC. $CB99 clears the request and sets response-ready $07F1.4. This is not the Consult opcode dispatcher.

label: mailbox_send
annotation: ===== Sends live data to the second CPU through the shared RAM ($0202, $0204, ... every second byte): rpm, load, trims, purge step, timing, CAL/LD, speed, battery, bits, and the pending C9 address. $029E = A5 means the other side is ready. (ROM_ANALYSIS.md §6)

label: dtc_task
annotation: ===== Fault bookkeeping task (writes dtc_conf / dtc_1st / ffrm).

label: dtc_from_subcpu
annotation: ===== Detection flags from the second CPU ($0E52-$0E57): bit n -> dtc_detect(slot 30h + n).

label: dtc_from_subcpu_2
annotation: More flags from the second CPU ($0E58 bits -> slots 22h, 12h, 14h, ...).

label: ffrm_capture

label: p1320_monitor
annotation: ===== P1320 ignition signal monitor (slot 8). Engine running, past start, RPM code >= 4: every 2nd call sample port P4 bit 3; each high sample = one miss (accumulates while the conditions hold); 10 misses -> dtc_detect(8), then the count restarts at 0. Enabled by CONFIG $120C.7. Fixed-rate slow task (sched slots 3/8), not synced to ignition.

label: switched_sensor_sequence
annotation: Toggle $095E.1 and save averaged samples of ADC $0C ($09FC); physical sensor/valve not established.
